# iliad-112 (17.384–480) — reviewer, pass 1

Method: runbook section 2. Notes checked label by label against the line; Greek to `l` word by word; `l` to `i`; remembered English checked against the house table (Iliad and Odyssey) and against shipped units for each repeated word; quotation marks and speech boundaries; continuity with `iliad-111.json` (its last unit, 17.381–383, is Nestor's charge to the two, narrative, no speech open, so nothing runs on into this part). `t` was not touched (checked: every `t` identical to the original draft, and every unit's `l` has as many lines as its `t`). The packet flags no scansion irregularities, so there were no hand scans to add. Severity scale: major = false statement or wrong sense in a reader-facing field; moderate = house-table violation, wrong grammatical label, or a note contradicting the line or its own `l`/`i`; minor = wording or precision.

## UNRESOLVED, needs `t` (reviewer may not touch it)

- 451/453 · t · major · The cut between the unit at 451 and the unit at 453 falls inside a phrase: the 451 unit's `t` ends `νῆας ἔπι` and the 453 unit's `t` begins `γλαφυράς· ἔτι γάρ …`. The stop is after γλαφυράς, and the two units' `l`, `i` and notes already treat γλαφυράς as belonging to the 451 unit (its `l` ends "to the hollow ships;", the 453 `l` begins "for still to them glory"). To be fixed by the orchestrator by script: move `γλαφυράς·` from the start of the 453 unit's `t` to the end of the 451 unit's third line (`νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς·`); the 453 unit's first line then reads `ἔτι γάρ σφισι κῦδος ὀρέξω`. No `l`, `i` or note then needs to change. (The `sc`/`tr` are made by the build, so nothing else is affected.)

## Findings considered and refused

- 384 ἑκάστου μαρναμένοιιν "each pair of opposed fighters": an interpretation, but the note says the Greek does not name the pairs. Left.
- 397 `i` "toil of battle" for μῶλος without Ἄρηος: the table's `i` for the whole phrase; here the note says "here the struggle" and Ares is named next line. Left.
- 395 ἔλπετο "hoped" against 404–407 "expect": deliberate (wish versus belief); note now says so. Left.
- 413 ἐνάριζον `l` "were slaying" against the table's `l` "slew" (9.530): imperfect of the same word; `i` "killed" is the table's. Left.
- 405 ἐνιχριμφθέντα `l` "pressed hard up against" (the table's 13.146 `i`); `l`/`i` mix is harmless here. Left.
- 426 `i` "standing apart" for ἐόντες: the horses are standing. Left.
- 471 `l`/`i` "has been killed" for the aorist ἀπέκτατο: the English perfect has the same force in this speech; the note labels the aorist. Left.
- 425 ἀτρυγέτοιο "unharvested upper air" of the air: follows the table's sea rows, note says meaning unknown. Left.
- 409/410 (Thetis unnamed): the note says so. Left.
- Repeated lines checked: 388 (iliad-100) `l` and `i` identical in the line; 442 (odyssey-024) identical; 455 (iliad-065) identical but for the necessary plural; 480 fixed (39).
